Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic After award of contract – Successful Bidder shall have to get Detailed Design Drawings approved from buyer before starting fabrication. Successful Bidder shall submit Detailed Design Drawings for Buyer's approval, within 5 days of award of contract. Buyer shall, either approve the drawings or will provide complete list of modification required in the drawings within 5 days. Seller shall be required to ensure supply as per approved Drawings with modifications as communicated by Buyer. If there is delay from buyer side in approval of drawing– the delivery period shall be refixed without LD for the period of delay in approval of Drawing. 3. DETAILS OF WORK Sr. No. Description Details

Installation of RO Water Filter in Zilla Parishad School @ various place 4 1 Name of Work Place Capacity 25 LPH 2 Estimated Amount Rs. 1,92,000/- Zilla Parishad School Various place a 3 Work Location t save 4 District Solapur, Maharashtra Supply, installation, testing and com 5 Nature of Work missioning of RO system 25 LPH 4 N OS Within 60 days from the date of wor 6 Completion Period k order 7 Last Date for Submission xxx/ 11 / 2026 8 Date of Opening xxx/ 11 / 2026 2. SPECIAL ELIGIBILITY CONDITIONS 1. The bidder/contractor must be based in Solapur District, Maharashtra, and must ha ve an office or service facility within Solapur District. 2. Since the work involves service and maintenance, the contractor must be capable of providing prompt after-sales service at the school site. 3. Physical inspection of the school premises before submission of the tender is comp ulsory. 4. After inspection, the contractor must obtain the prescribed Site Inspection Report duly signed by the Sarpanch or Gramsevak of the concerned village. 5. The inspection report must record the water source, inlet water TDS, proposed RO installation location, pipeline distances, electrical supply, drainage arrangements and all materials required to make the RO system fully operational. 6. The duly signed Site Inspection Report must be attached to the tender. Tenders su bmitted without this report may be treated as incomplete. 7. The contractor shall include in the quoted amount all materials, fittings, pipeline, wiring, transportation, labour, installation and commissioning expenses required for a complete working system. 3. GENERAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS 1. The tender shall be submitted in the prescribed manner, duly filled in and signed, along with all required supporting documents. 2. The quoted rate shall clearly state whether GST and all applicable taxes are includ ed. Transportation, labour, installation, testing, fittings and commissioning charges s hall be included in the quoted amount. 3. All equipment and components supplied shall be new, genuine, of good quality an d suitable for the intended use.

4. The RO system capacity and technical specifications shall be suitable for the schoo l's requirements and the quality of the available raw water. 5. The contractor shall provide all components required for proper operation, includin g suitable pre-filters, sediment filter, activated carbon filter, RO membrane, pumps, p ost-filter, storage tank, valves, connectors and necessary accessories, as applicable. 6. The contractor shall arrange and complete all required pipeline work, plumbing, el ectrical connections, drainage connections and fittings necessary to make the syste m fully operational. 7. After installation, the contractor shall test the complete system and record inlet an d treated-water outlet TDS readings. The test report shall be handed over to the con cerned authority/school. 8. The contractor shall explain the operation and routine maintenance of the system to the concerned school staff. 9. The contractor shall provide a minimum warranty of ______ months for the supplied system and workmanship. Warranty terms shall be clearly mentioned in the quotatio n. 10. Any defect arising from defective material or workmanship during the warranty p eriod shall be rectified by the contractor at no additional cost, subject to the stated w arranty terms. 11. The work shall be completed within the stipulated period and to the satisfaction o f the competent authority. 12. Payment shall be made only after satisfactory completion, testing, submission of required documents and certification by the competent authority, as per applicable r ules. 13. The competent authority reserves the right to accept or reject any or all tenders, or cancel the tender process, in accordance with applicable rules. 14. Any misrepresentation, submission of false documents or failure to comply with t ender conditions may result in rejection of the tender. 15. All applicable government procurement rules, safety requirements and instructio ns of the competent authority shall be followed. 4. DOCUMENTS TO BE SUBMITTED WITH THE TENDER 1. Identity proof of the contractor/proprietor. 2. PAN card. 3. Business registration / contractor registration certificate, wherever applicable. 4. GST registration certificate, if applicable. 5. Proof of office or service facility in Solapur District. 6. Details of relevant experience in RO water purifier installation/service, if available. 7. Duly signed Site Inspection Report (Annexure A). 8. Item-wise quotation showing equipment, materials, installation and other charges.
